mutation FlxMailSettingsUpdate($input: FlxMailSettingsUpdateInput!) {
  flxMailSettingsUpdate(input: $input) {
    settings {
      ...FlxMailSettings
    }
    errors {
      code
      message
      field
    }
  }
}
